textures.name: floor-planks
textures.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square seamless tileable material texture for the Soul Meter walk-in building kit.
House style: gothic mythopunk.
Subject: Weathered floor planks: six narrow horizontal rows of long worn oak boards, staggered butt joints, fine broken grain, bruised edges and rubbed pale brown high points. Damp peat brown, charcoal grain; no orange varnish. The planks run horizontally, parallel to the image x axis. A subtle mix of broad painted strokes and fine wear that remains legible when reduced to a 64 by 32 isometric ground tile. The top and bottom edges meet as ordinary plank joints, no border.
Composition: straight-on orthographic surface swatch, 1024 by 1024, edge-to-edge opaque material; no perspective, no silhouette, no margin. Exact opposite edges must tile. Material detail is lit from the upper left consistently. Apply the dramatic lighting language to local relief; leave broad illumination seamless because the 3D renderer provides the overall directional key and atmospheric falloff. No radial vignette baked into a repeatable material.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, signage, symbols, names, people, bodies, creatures, objects, borders or watermark; no Ofshütje or Hollow depiction. No cyan or violet glow.

**Rendering style:** semi-realistic painterly digital illustration — closer to dark-fantasy concept art than to flat vector/pixel art or a clean 3D-kit render. Rich surface detail (wear, rust, moss, wet sheen) rendered through paint-like shading rather than flat color fills or hard cel outlines.

**Lighting:** dramatic, directional key light with a darker falloff/vignette around the subject. Avoid flat, evenly-lit "asset kit" lighting — every piece should look like it was lit for atmosphere, not for orthographic clarity alone.

**Palette:** Base surfaces: charcoal/near-black stone, blue-black masonry, wet dark iron. Institutional metal: iron and tarnished bronze, reserved for ceremonial/important elements. Magic/the Wound: restrained violet, cyan, pale bone-white — used as small local accents, never an all-over glow. Organic life: deep moss/algae green, damp peat brown, occasional demon-heat red-orange. Overall: desaturated and dark by default, with a small number of deliberate saturated accents per asset (fire, magic, decay) rather than broad bright color.
textures.reason: Obvious repeating bright patch in assembled floor; retry for even broad exposure.
